purpose: Hard identity contract for every Dominic generation. Real user-supplied photos and real user-video-derived frames are the only permitted facial identity authority.
separationRules: Identity sources define face geometry, hair, brows, eyes, nose, mouth, jaw, stubble and skin tone.
Motion/performance sources may define only movement, rhythm, posture, gaze behavior and micro-expression vocabulary.
Scene, wardrobe and lighting references may never redefine the face.
When a real identity source cannot be materialized, generation must stop instead of substituting another face.
generationRules: For exactIdentityAuthority jobs, use one fixed validated real-user master identity for prelock and every video frame.
Never switch identity source because another reference matches the target pose better.
The generated scene, camera and motion must adapt to Dominic; Dominic must not adapt into a generated lookalike.
Prefer minimal animation until exact visual identity is proven.
Never use a generated portrait as first frame, last frame or identity restore authority.
Never approve a candidate from technical QA or similarity score alone.
rejectRules: Reject if the face is not unmistakably the exact same Dominic as the fixed real master.
Reject any generic-handsome-man or model-like reinterpretation even when similarity score is high.
Reject if jaw width/shape, eye color/spacing, brows, nose, mouth, hairline, hair texture, stubble or skin tone visibly drift.
Reject if any sampled frame becomes another man or visibly changes identity.
Reject any duplicate mouth, jaw, chin, neck seam, halo, UI or clothing copied into an identity patch.
Reject if identity source provenance is not real-user-supplied or real-user-video-derived.

exactIdentityPolicy.masterSelection: first validated real-user reference embedded by the worker; current runner prioritizes 00-dominic-clean-real-anchor.jpg derived from /private/monia/lucas/source.mp4 at second 26
exactIdentityPolicy.secondaryReferences: QA, motion, pose understanding and continuity support only; they may never redefine Dominic facial identity
